title: PBMC, scRNA-seq group 1
treatment_protocol_ch1: Dead cells were removed using a bead based kit (STEMCELL Technologies #17899), and hashed using TotalSeq-A antibodies. Each sample was pooled in equal ratios and stained with the TotalSeq™-A Human Universal Cocktail, V1.0 (Bioledgend #399907). Pools were then lysed on ice with DIG lysis buffer for 5 minutes before washing. Cells werethen loaded into the 10X Chromium controller (10x Genomics) according to the manufacturer protocol. CD4+ T cells samples were additionally negatively selected using Miltenyi Biotech #130-096-533.
extract_protocol_ch1: cDNA, transposed cDNA, and CITE cDNA were extracted according to the 10X multiome protocol with the modifications described in Mimitou et al.Nat. Biotechnol. 2021.
Libraries were constructed using the 10X multiome protocol with the modificaitons described in Mimitou et al. Nat. Biotechnol. 2021.
data_processing: Raw reads were processed using the Cellranger arc pipeline (version 2.0.1) with default parameters, CITE reads were processed with Kite (https://github.com/pachterlab/kite) and Kallisto (version 0.48.0).
